_doc: LaunchAgents whose program is ad-hoc signed or sits on a versioned path, and why that is fine. docs/tcc.md. A label not listed here makes `make tcc-check` fail. class: launcher = file access is covered by herdr-core-launcher's Full Disk Access; no-grant = the job touches no TCC-protected folder (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, iCloud, other apps' data).

com.jkrumm.herdr-core.why: program is herdr-core-launcher, which holds the Full Disk Access grant; the core is its child

com.iu.prometheus-dashboard-autodeploy.why: python3 in a Cellar path; works in ~/IuRoot only

com.iu.teamchat-runtime-deploy.why: python3 in a Cellar path; works in ~/IuRoot only

com.iu.prometheus-vpn-watcher.why: uv python; touches the VPN client and ~/IuRoot only

com.jkrumm.modelpick-web.why: bun in a Cellar path; serves from ~/SourceRoot

com.jkrumm.weatherorb.watchdog.why: uv in a Cellar path; ~/SourceRoot only

com.jkrumm.collie.why: compiled bridge under ~/.local/share/collie; touches only its own config, state and log

herdr.collie.why: classic herdr plugin binary, retires with Wave 7

homebrew.mxcl.sleepwatcher.why: runs ~/.sleep and ~/.wakeup, which touch nothing protected

homebrew.mxcl.ntfy-mac.why: notification relay; no file access outside its own state
